title: Continuous extension of a set map to the ultrafilter space
statement: For any set $S$, use the ultrafilter space $\mathcal U(S)$ with topology and notation as in [lem-weil-pbc-ultrafilter-compact-hausdorff-basis]. Let $K$ be a compact Hausdorff space and let $f:S\to K$ be any function; no topology or continuity assumption is imposed on $S$ or $f$. For $s\in S$ let $p(s)=\{A\subseteq S:s\in A\}$ be its principal ultrafilter. There is a continuous function $\widehat f:\mathcal U(S)\to K$ such that $\widehat f(p(s))=f(s)$ for every $s\in S$.
